alt: A short film with no voice. A lavender bedroom. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes sits on a bed staring down at a phone while a small clock on the floor counts up, 9 min, 21 min, 34 min. Its eyes narrow as the minutes pass. At 47 min its eyes go wide and it looks at the camera, caught, then narrows them and looks back down at the phone. The text stays: if this found you: that quick check was 47 minutes. The app says thanks.
